name: Bio-Techne
description: Bio-Techne makes the biological ingredients and tests that scientists use in experiments: proteins, antibodies and assays (R&D Systems, Tocris, Novus Biologicals), automated protein-analysis instruments (ProteinSimple) and, in a smaller segment, diagnostic controls sold to instrument makers and spatial-biology tools (ACD RNAscope, Lunaphore). The reagent segment, 72% of sales, earns a 41% segment margin because it is thousands of small repeat purchases of its own-manufactured products; the diagnostics and spatial segment earns only 11%. On 2026-06-25 it agreed to be acquired by Merck KGaA for $73.00 per share in cash, expected to close by late 2026 or early 2027, so buybacks are suspended and the share price follows the deal.

employees.note: Full-time and part-time; about 2,200 in the U.S. and 800 outside.

businessLines.name: Protein Sciences
businessLines.how: Sells research proteins (cytokines, growth factors, antibodies, cGMP-grade proteins for cell and gene therapy makers) and protein-analysis tools (ProteinSimple automated western blot, multiplex immunoassays) to academic, pharma, biotech and CRO labs; high-volume repeat reagent purchases, with instruments pulling through consumables; partly sold via a Thermo Fisher distribution agreement.

businessLines.name: Diagnostics and Spatial Biology
businessLines.how: Sells diagnostic calibrators and controls mostly OEM to instrument makers (repeat reagent supply), plus spatial-biology assays and instruments (ACD RNAscope, Lunaphore COMET) and Asuragen genetic and oncology kits to research and clinical labs.

brands.name: R&D Systems, Novus Biologicals, Tocris Bioscience
brands.note: Reagent Solutions brands (Protein Sciences segment, $874.6M, 72% of net sales); brand revenue not broken out.

brands.name: ProteinSimple
brands.note: Analytical Solutions brand (automated western blot and multiplex immunoassays).

brands.name: ACD (RNAscope), Lunaphore COMET, Asuragen
brands.note: Diagnostics and Spatial Biology segment brands ($336.4M, 28% of net sales); brand revenue not broken out.

brands.name: Lunaphore SA
brands.note: Spatial biology (COMET hyperplex instrument); acquired at the start of fiscal 2024; inside Diagnostics and Spatial Biology; revenue not broken out.

brands.name: Wilson Wolf Corporation
brands.note: 19.9% investment (fiscal 2023) with an obligation to buy the remaining ownership by end of calendar 2027, earlier on revenue or EBITDA targets.

whatsNext.text: Merger with Merck KGaA: each share converts to $73.00 cash; needs shareholder approval (proxy filed 2026-08-20) and regulatory approvals including HSR; termination fee payable by Bio-Techne about $230.5 million in specified cases.
